output.name: Halesk

anatomy.part: body, the heart of the bird

output.myth: When Aun cut the string, the first gull to fly after the sky was Halesk, and she was too proud to come down. She hung over the Unflown with her neck stretched up like a hand asking for rain, and she has not moved since. Where her shadow lies the sea goes flat as a plate, and no wind reaches the drowned there. Tavo came laughing and threw his whole weight at her, and she did not stir. Aun asked why she would not fly home. She said she was waiting for Kael to bring her a road, and Kael still casts for it, and still comes up empty. So when you find yourself in a dead calm and the gulls go quiet, do not shout. Hesk counts the still ones on her Reel, and Sil follows the silence down looking for her brother. Keep your sails tied and your hands on the rope, and wait like Halesk waits.
output.verse:
Still gull in the deep,
no wind reaches her, sea lies flat,
keep your hands on rope.
